editorial.name: cosmicThreePointO/use-scroll-fades
editorial.descriptionZh: 一个 React hook，给任意可滚动容器自动补上渐隐遮罩，提示上下还有内容；无运行时依赖，用 mask-image 实现。
editorial.takeawayZh: 一行 hook 给滚动容器补上下渐隐边
editorial.noteZh: About 栏的简介写着 A lightweight React hook that automatically manages fade overlays for scrollable containers，并标了 MIT license。README 的章节从 Installation、Visual Examples、Quick Start (New Mask-Image Approach) 排到 Gradient Color Customization、Browser Support、Horizontal Scrolling、Configuration Options。文件树里 src、demo-site、docs、tests 四个目录各自带着提交说明，Releases 10 个、最新 v3.4.0。

reasons.statement: 这个仓库交付的是一段滚动交互代码：hook 在容器上下边缘生成渐变遮罩，随滚动位置淡入淡出（README 的 Quick Start 走 mask-image 方案，另有 Gradient Color Customization 与 Animation Options 两节），属于动效与微交互实现，所以归 visual-implementation 下的 motion-interaction-code，而不是通用组件库。About 栏标 MIT license。

pages.title: GitHub - cosmicThreePointO/use-scroll-fades: A lightweight React hook that automatically manages fade overlays for scrollable containers. Provides smooth gradient transitions at the top and bottom edges to visually indicate when there's more content to scroll. Features automatic content change detection, performance optimization with RAF throttling, and full TypeScript support. · GitHub
